text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Maki-chan... What's the matter, 
bringing that all the way out here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"We came today to celebrate Dober-chan's 
birthday~"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I see, thank you. But what 
happened with Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I don't kno~w. But I have a message from 
Bright-chan for you~"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"'Saying "Thank you as always, I know how 
kind you are, Dober-chan, and how hard 
you've been trying, too."'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Bright-chan also said that she loves... 
how you always get embarrassed and run off 
whenever she says things like that~"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Geez, what's that supposed to mean... 
Though, seeing it through Maki-chan, 
maybe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. Maki-chan. Could I leave a 
message for Bright too?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks for everything, always. I know 
I'm a handful, but I hope we can keep 
getting along, y'know?"
